Plan: ## Plan: ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no changes made)  I walked the full chain: `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, plus `useAuth.tsx` and `db/auth.ts`.
